summary: Re-tested Tennis Player Auction after auth migration from email/password to Team Code + 6-digit PIN with admin/captain roles. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases PASS (auth code+PIN, /auth/me for admin and captain, wrong PIN -> 401, unknown code -> 401, case-insensitive code, /api/config shape, captain cannot create/finalize/skip/reset (403), admin cannot bid (403), captain can bid OWN team (200), captain bidding OTHER team -> 403, admin can create/skip/reset, unique-bid rule, base-price, increment, budget-reserve rule, full admin-create -> TEAM1 bid -> admin sees via GET -> admin finalize -> player awarded with budget/totalSpent/pool/acquiredPrice all updated). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): wrong-PIN shows 'Invalid code or PIN' error; ADMIN session shows Create New Auction and NO captain-banner; TEAM1 session shows captain-banner and NO create button; ADMIN auction screen renders 14 read-only team-status-* cards, finalize/skip/reset buttons, no my-team-card; TEAM1 auction screen renders 1 my-team-card (bid-input-1, chip-1-12000, place-bid-1) + 13 read-only team-status-* and NO finalize/skip/reset; TEAM1 successfully placed $12,000 bid (my-team-card shows 'Your bid $12,000 · WINNING'), ADMIN polling reflected it (team-status-1 shows '$12,000 · LEAD'), admin finalize succeeded and pool advanced. Found and fixed 1 bug: the live auction-screen Header was not passing canReset={isAdmin}, so reset-button (refresh icon) was hidden for admin in the main screen (only visible on auction-complete). Fixed by adding the prop; verified reset-button + reset-modal now render for admin.

ui_bugs.issue: Fixed: live auction-screen Header was missing canReset={isAdmin} so reset-button was not rendered for admin during a running auction (was only correct on auction-complete branch). Reference: /app/frontend/app/auction/[id].tsx:370-377

react_native_issues.issue: Benign 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning likely from a transitive RN/Expo dep — not actionable in app code.
Benign React 19 'Accessing element.ref was removed' from a transitive lib (likely @expo/vector-icons / react-native-safe-area-context) — no functional impact.

action_items: (Already fixed by tester) Ensure canReset is passed in the main auction-screen Header so admin gets reset-button + reset-modal during a live session.
Optional (carry-over from iter_1): /api/auctions/{sid}/reset bypasses optimistic-concurrency (raw $set with new version) — could silently overwrite an in-flight bid. Consider version-gated reset.
Optional: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event hooks; switch to lifespan context.
Captain auction screen does NOT render a reset icon (correct by design); confirm captains never need to restart their own client beyond logout.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth flow is clean: bcrypt PIN hashing (with 72-byte safe slice), JWT with role+teamId+name in claims, idempotent code-based seeding on startup, migration that drops legacy email_1 index.
Captain authorization correctly enforced server-side in /auctions/{sid}/bid: requires role=captain AND user.teamId == req.teamId (admins also rejected from bidding — matches review_request).
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL only; testIDs present on all interactive elements; StyleSheet.create everywhere; all text inside Text components.
AuthContext persists token via SecureStore (storage.secureSet) and user via AsyncStorage — appropriate split.

rca_of_issue: Bug RCA: auction/[id].tsx defines two render branches — auction-complete (line 182-) and auction-screen (line 370-). Both render the shared <Header /> with onReset/onBack/etc. The complete-screen branch passes canReset={isAdmin} (line 188) but the live-screen branch (line 372-377) was missing the prop, so canReset defaulted to undefined/false and the reset Pressable was guarded out (line 533). Fix: add canReset={isAdmin} to the live Header invocation. Verified after expo restart that reset-button and reset-modal now render for admin during a live session.
